title: F-18 PET Bone Scans Versus Tc-99m Bone Scans for the Diagnosis of Bone Metastases
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare 18F-Fluoride PET bone scans to traditional 99mTc-MDP bone scan to determine if one is better for diagnosing bone metastases.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient has cancer
* Has been referred for evaluation of bone metastases
* Patient or patient's legal representative can understand and consent to enrollment in the study
* Must be 18 years or older
* Can remain still during the scan (approximately one hour)
* Patient has Medicare

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient does not have Medicare
* Under the age of 18
* Cannot lie still for the necessary time
study_population: Patients who have cancer and have been referred for evaluation for bone metastases.
